final_lessons: For richer multivariate regression, depth and width can outweigh the residual penalty: a very deep, wide residual MLP may beat a shallow plain network when no strong plain deep option is present.
With SGD on higher-dimensional regression, extra depth can hurt more than it helps; a wide but relatively shallow plain ReLU MLP may beat deeper stacks even on complex symbolic targets.
For bigram LM, longer context depth is unnecessary; a small single-layer transformer with enough embedding width can beat deeper or much larger variants, especially under strong regularization.

For bigram LM under strong regularization, compact transformers remain best; when forced to use more than one layer, keeping d_model small still beats much larger models, and a somewhat larger FF block can help.
For this normalized regression MLP, conservative Adam can beat both Adagrad and plain SGD even at modest budget; Adam at 1e-2 was too aggressive, but 1e-4 was not too slow here.
For this regression MLP, SGD with momentum at a moderate LR outperformed both conservative RMSprop and plain SGD; the adaptive/slow heuristic does not transfer automatically across optimizer grids.
This regression optimizer grid consistently favored SGD with momentum over Adagrad and plain SGD, while Adam at 1e-2 stayed too aggressive.

Under Adam at short budget, a deep residual MLP with decent width and some layer norm can outperform a shallow plain network by a lot; residual depth is not always a liability in the fast-adaptation regime.
At short Adam budgets, a balanced non-residual MLP with moderate depth, substantial width, and layer norm can dominate both very narrow deep models and extremely shallow wide ones.

With noisy training labels and long low-LR SGD, a medium-width deeper plain MLP can beat both shallow residual models and very narrow networks; moderate capacity plus depth can denoise better than a shallow bias-variance compromise.

In noisy-label mixed setups, the best package can be a balanced combination of moderate Adam, mild explicit regularization, and a reasonably deep residual MLP; too-strong regularization or weaker optimizers can lose badly.

In this noisy mixed regime, a medium-depth plain MLP with standard Adam at 1e-3 beat both the simpler AdamW option and the more exotic heavily regularized alternatives; mild architectural complexity plus straightforward optimization was enough.
